title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje te “Golden Tower Residence” 270,000 €
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 në kompleksin “Golden Tower Residence” , një ndër ndërtimet më cilësore në zonën e Mine Pezës.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 banim dhe organizohet nga:
• 1 dhome ndenje bashke me ambientin e gatimit.
• 2 dhoma gjumi
• 1 tualet
• 1 ballkon
Apartamenti ka investime extra si :
• Sistemi elektrik
• Instalime hidraulike të reja
• Tavan i varur i përfunduar me kujdes
• Parket i shtruar (jo i firmës ndërtuese)
Orientimi Jug-Lindje i apartamentit mundeson ndriçim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in "Golden Tower Residence" €270,000
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the "Golden Tower Residence" complex, one of the best quality buildings in the Mine Peza area. The apartment is located on the 8th residential floor and is organized by: • 1 living room with a kitchen area. • 2 bedrooms • 1 bathroom • 1 balcony The apartment has extra investments such as: • Electrical system • New plumbing • Suspended ceiling carefully finished • Paved parquet (not from the construction company) South-East orientation of the apartment allows natural lighting throughout the day.
